GitHub #642 (mitcad#2383; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/shell-sharp-reported-test.cmake): Body1 (F2.b0), a cone on a ring revolved from Sketch1 (Revolve1 F2), a side boss along a pipe (Pipe1 F8, Extrude1 F7) and five notches cut up from the ring's top through the cone's wall (Extrude2 F10, CircularPattern1 F11). The report's Shell: Inside 2 mm, Sharp, Tangent Chain on, the boss top and the foot removed. It failed ('the offset faces do not close up') at any thickness, no face vanishing: the geometry kernel's offset split the cone's foot, cut by the notches and the cone's seam, wrongly (OCCT port patch 2383). It builds into one solid: the step's top measured 2 mm from its inside, every notch's round end with the inside of its wall.
The step's top (z = 80) with its inside 2 mm below.
Each notch's round end with the inside of its wall (a notch whose walls the cone's inside ran across had none).
The cone's inside, and the volume of the wall (the geometry kernel's 55678.2 mm3 in the OCCT lab; Rounded gives 55359.1).
